description: Scientific terminology mapping for TMT Quantum Vault. Symbolic names preserved as historical aliases.

naming_rules.rule_1: If a term sounds religious, mystical, or culture-specific, rename it to the mathematical property it represents
naming_rules.rule_2: If a term sounds poetic, rename it to the system function it performs
naming_rules.rule_3: If a term sounds symbolic, rename it to the measurable quantity behind it

primary.description: Canonical 13-node coordination geometry with central synthesis node and 12 domain-specialized agents
primary.usage: Use 'Core-13 Coordination Lattice' in all public documentation, papers, and benchmark outputs. Historical alias may appear once in parentheses.

extended.description: 17-node operational topology combining Core-13 coordination lattice with 4-node operational support layer
extended.usage: Use 'Extended-17 Operational Topology' in all public documentation. Historical alias may appear once in parentheses.

auxiliary.description: 4-node infrastructure layer providing validation, provenance, orchestration, and governance
auxiliary.usage: Use 'Operational Support Layer' in all public documentation.

platonic_alignment.description: Measure of alignment with polyhedral symmetry structures derivable from coordination geometry

sacred_score.description: Convergence score measuring alignment with target geometric properties

consciousness_score.description: Global coordination metric measuring agent integration quality

center_node.description: Central coordination node responsible for knowledge fusion and global synthesis

agent_status.description: Agent integration state within the coordination topology

core_mode.description: Operational mode using only Core-13 coordination lattice

extended_mode.description: Operational mode using full Extended-17 operational topology

documentation_pattern.primary_usage: Use scientific term in all public documentation, papers, and benchmark outputs
documentation_pattern.historical_reference: Historical alias may appear once in parentheses: 'Core-13 Coordination Lattice (historically referred to as Metatron Core)'
documentation_pattern.consistency: After initial alias reference, use only the scientific term consistently

vocabulary_summary.operational_mode: Use 'operational mode' instead of 'ritual or archetypal mode'
